name: Tokyo Princess Bot
description: Telegram bot to save files in database from channels, searchable via inline mode.

CHANNELS.description: Username or ID of channel or group. Separate multiple IDs by space.

ADMINS.description: Username or ID of Admin. Separate multiple Admins by space.

PICS.description: Add some telegraph link of pictures.

AUTH_USERS.description: Users allowed for inline search. Separate by space.

AUTH_CHANNEL.description: ID of channel for mandatory subscription.

DATABASE_URI2.description: Second MongoDB URI for multiple DB mode.

PORT.description: Port to run web server (Koyeb requirement)
